title: Separate DEA registration for each principal place of business
rule_summary: A separate DEA registration is required for each principal place of business or professional practice at one general physical location where controlled substances are manufactured, distributed, imported, exported, or dispensed by a person.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate knows that federal registration is premises-based, so a second premises is not covered by the registration held for the first.
common_confusions: Federal law is premises-based as well as state law, so a per-premises requirement is not a Massachusetts-only feature.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1301.12(a) on ecfr.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
